summary: Six churches in a family of parishes around LeRoy and Batavia. The p1 Mass and Confession boxes agree in all five bulletins read, and the weekday intentions match them. Included: Thursday Adoration at Our Lady of Mercy, a First Friday 10 AM Mass at Holy Name of Mary, a Nov 9 Brigid Mass and one-off Oct 25 7:30 AM Masses at Holy Name and St. Cecilia. Open: Tuesday Confession at Holy Name, given only as before and after Mass.
